title: One thing at a time — идиомы

items.idiom: do less work in a day
items.example: Multi-taskers do less work in a day than others.
items.mnemonic: Лентяй ушёл в лес и делает меньше работы — do less work.

items.example: When you multi-task, you forget names and numbers.
items.mnemonic: Клерк с фургоном забывает имена — forget names and numbers.

items.example: I can't remember normal things easily.
items.mnemonic: Студент с мемом не запоминает — can't remember easily.

items.example: Multi-taskers eat very fast and too much.
items.mnemonic: Торопыга с фастфудом ест очень быстро — eat very fast.

items.example: You don't think about food, so you eat too much.
items.mnemonic: Болельщик на матче переедает — eat too much.

items.example: Finally, your stress levels go up.
items.mnemonic: Стрелка ползёт вверх от стресса — stress levels go up.

items.example: Turn off your phone and just talk and listen.
items.mnemonic: Гости на ток-шоу просто говорят и слушают — just talk and listen.
